name: Meetily
description: Privacy-first desktop meeting assistant that records, transcribes locally and generates summaries without sending audio to the cloud.
whatItDoes: Captures meeting audio on the user's computer, produces a live transcript and writes summaries and action items. It is meant for people who cannot share recordings with third-party services.
howItWorks: A Rust desktop application captures microphone and system audio and transcribes it with local Parakeet or Whisper models. Summaries come from a local model or a provider the user selects. Prebuilt installers are published, and the README also documents building from source with GPU support.

requirements.name: Summary model
requirements.description: Local model server or an external provider key for summaries

models: Parakeet or Whisper for speech; local or hosted LLMs for summaries
